policy.access: Public unauthenticated endpoints only. No login, paywall, robots.txt, bot-detection, CAPTCHA, rate-limit or subscription bypass.
policy.timestamps: A fetch time is never substituted for a publication time. Date-only values remain unverified and cannot satisfy the 15:00 to 09:00 cutoff.
policy.activation: Only ACTIVE endpoints may appear as enabled sources.json poll sources. Blocked, not-found, unreachable and registry-only endpoints stay disabled and retain their access evidence.
policy.scope: Official exchanges, regulators, government departments and a partial evidence-based catalog of listed-issuer IR/press pages. Absence from this registry does not imply exhaustive coverage.
